hooks.command: PY=; for c in python python3; do if command -v "$c" >/dev/null 2>&1 && "$c" -c "" </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1; then PY="$c"; break; fi; done; if [ -n "$PY" ] && [ -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.schemalock/hook.py" ]; then "$PY" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.schemalock/hook.py"; else printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"SchemaLock did not run: Python or hook.py not found"}}'; exit 0; fi
